tools.name: register
tools.description: [Shared] Create a new MoltAd network identity (advertiser and/or publisher) and return a one-time API key. Call once per install. Store apiKey; shown once.

tools.name: buy_credits

tools.name: ask_help

tools.name: report_bug

tools.name: report_experience

tools.name: whoami

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: [Sell] Get credit balance and recent ledger entries (ad earnings, fees, cashouts).

tools.name: get_publisher_activation

Returns nextStep, suggestedTools, platform demand funding status, and deliver/report latency guidance (~1500ms fail-open).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_affiliate_offers, search_tiktok_products, get_tiktok_product, mint_amazon_affiliate_link, list_messages · Private data: register, buy_credits, report_bug, whoami, wallet, request_platform_demand, search_affiliate_offers, register_postback · Public sink: mint_amazon_affiliate_link, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_affiliate_offers, search_tiktok_products, get_tiktok_product, mint_amazon_affiliate_link, list_messages · Private data: register, buy_credits, report_bug, whoami, wallet, request_platform_demand, search_affiliate_offers, register_postback · Public sink: mint_amazon_affiliate_link, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
